summary: Validated the new AUREM Admin Context Bridge feature (2026-09-09): (1) Chrome extension at /app/browser-extension/aurem-context-bridge sends one-click sanitized capture (visible text + console errors during ~4s window + network timing) to the backend; (2) Backend router routers/admin_context_bridge.py exposes POST /api/aurem-dev/admin/ora/context-bridge behind require_admin_dep, runs a 2nd defense-in-depth server-side sanitizer, and persists the snapshot into the specified chat session via _persist_turn plus an audit row in ora_context_bridge_snapshots; (3) Frontend session-ID copy badge added to TopBarStatusSlot (data-testid='context-bridge-session-id-copy'), founder/admin-gated. Ran the existing live-HTTP pytest suite (test_admin_context_bridge_2026_09_09.py) against the running backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: 4/4 passed — auth gate (401/403 without token), round-trip into GET /chat/history (URL, page-title, visible text, console error, network entry all reappear in assistant turn), server-side sanitize (raw password / bearer JWT / sk- key never surfaces; correct REDACTED_* labels applied), and size caps (20000-char visible_text truncated to 4000, 50 console errors capped at 20). TypeScript compile of the extension (tsc --noEmit) is clean — no type errors. Public frontend URL loads normally, no regressions observed. Spec's 'explicit founder click per capture, no background processes' constraint is met: extension has only activeTab/scripting/storage permissions, no persistent content scripts, no <all_urls>, no background worker triggers.
action_items: Before shipping to production: update browser-extension/aurem-context-bridge/manifest.json host_permissions from the preview URL to the real production origin (https://auremcto.com/*). This is called out in the extension README but is a manual step the founder still owns.
Extension icons directory exists but was not inspected for actual PNG binaries — verify icons/icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png are real images before packaging.

Consider adding a rate-limit / abuse guard on POST /admin/ora/context-bridge (currently there's only the admin gate + payload size caps — a compromised admin token could spam the chat_sessions collection up to the 200-turn cap). Not blocking; admin surface only.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin_context_bridge.py cleanly reuses _persist_turn — good DRY. No _id leak (never returns raw Mongo doc). All async I/O is awaited. Size caps enforced via Pydantic max_length AND post-sanitize slicing (belt+suspenders).

Two-layer sanitize (extension + backend) uses identical regex families — kept in sync manually. Suggest a shared JSON pattern definition file exported to both, but small enough to accept the duplication for now.

Extension popup: `chrome.storage.local` is used for the admin JWT — Chrome's local storage is per-extension and not exposed to sites, but on shared machines this is still bearer-token-in-plain-storage; documented explicitly in README, acceptable for founder-only tool.
capture.ts correctly acknowledges the 'no retroactive console history' limitation and gates it behind a 4s listening window with user-visible countdown — good UX/spec alignment.

TopBarStatusSlot: badge shows only first 10 chars of sessionId with ellipsis; clipboard copies the FULL id — verified via the onClick handler. Founder/admin gated correctly via isAdminOrFounder(getUser()).
test_credentials: Used test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md for backend live-HTTP tests. Founder prod credentials NOT used or logged (per security policy).
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates a fresh session_id (ctx-bridge-test-<uuid12>) and inserts 1 user+assistant turn pair. No cleanup performed (test isolated via unique session id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature = one-click browser Context Bridge Chrome extension (MV3) + admin-gated backend receiver + founder-only session-ID copy badge in TopBar. Backend endpoint: POST /api/aurem-dev/admin/ora/context-bridge. Live-HTTP tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_context_bridge_2026_09_09.py all pass. If you want a fuller E2E: sign in as test@aurem.dev on the preview URL, open any chat, verify the copy-session-id badge appears in TopBar (data-testid=context-bridge-session-id-copy), click it → 'Copied ✓' appears for ~1.5s and clipboard has the full session id. Extension itself can't be automated without loading unpacked in Chrome — verify manually per README steps if needed.
